```powershell
Write-Output '=== JOB 542 - THE WORLD GETS DESIGNED AND THE LEVELS GET LINKED (Ground: Tyree at his screen sees cylinders and scattered shapes, the background reads random, and the levels stand unlinked. This job loads the district, counts what stands, clears the scattered spiral dressing, and places cliff walls along two valley ridges that frame a clear run toward the beacon, plaza kept clear. It then censuses the maps in the project and the streaming levels on the district, and prints the link call it finds so the link lands on evidence. It saves the district in the same job and prints its page. No game relaunch rides this job. Every variable carries the p542 prefix.) ==='
$p542b64 = ''
$p542py = 'D:\VEIL-OMNI\Saved\world542.py'
[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($p542py, [Convert]::FromBase64String($p542b64))
$p542cmd = 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe'
$p542proc = Start-Process -FilePath $p542cmd -ArgumentList @('"D:\VEIL-OMNI\VEIL.uproject"', '-run=pythonscript', ('-script="' + $p542py + '"'), '-unattended', '-nopause', '-nosplash') -PassThru
Write-Output ('WORLD LAUNCHED pid=' + $p542proc.Id)
$p542poll = 0
while (-not $p542proc.HasExited -and $p542poll -lt 19) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 10; $p542poll = $p542poll + 1 }
Write-Output ('CMD POLLS=' + $p542poll + ' exited=' + $p542proc.HasExited)
$p542page = 'D:\VEIL-OMNI\Saved\world542.txt'
if (Test-Path $p542page) { Get-Content $p542page | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('PAGE ' + $_) } } else { Write-Output 'PAGE STILL MISSING' }
if (-not $p542proc.HasExited) { Write-Output 'CMD STILL RUNNING - PAGE RIDES THE NEXT READ' }
Write-Output 'PHI P542 VERDICT: WORLD PAGE PRINTED ABOVE'
Write-Output 'JOB 542 DONE'
```
